title: Intersections of Mind and Machine: Navigating the Nexus of Artificial Intelligence, Science Education, and the Preparation of Pre-service Teachers
venue: Journal of Science Education and Technology
extended_summary:
This editorial examines the growing role of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) in science education, with a particular focus on how it may affect the preparation of pre-service teachers (PSTs). The paper asks whether GenAI is genuinely transformative for education or whether it is another example of the recurring cycle of technological hype that has historically surrounded new tools such as radio, television, and computers.

Rather than testing a specific intervention, the article synthesises and positions the contributions in a special issue on GenAI and science teacher education. It discusses how GenAI can support lesson planning, personalised learning, inquiry-based learning, writing, and pedagogical content knowledge development, while also raising concerns about bias, hallucinations, privacy, data security, and over-reliance on AI-generated outputs. The context is initial teacher education and science education, especially among PSTs who are already experimenting with GenAI for university coursework and preparation for teaching.

The paper concludes that teacher education programs should provide structured support for GenAI literacy, critical evaluation of AI outputs, and ethical reflection. The authors argue that PSTs need both technical proficiency and critical judgment to use GenAI responsibly and pedagogically soundly. Overall, the editorial frames GenAI as a tool with real potential, but one whose educational value depends on careful integration, human mentorship, and sustained institutional support.

identified_tools.name: ChatGPT
identified_tools.description: An OpenAI GPT-based conversational large language model used for generating and rewriting text.
identified_tools.use_case: Used during the writing process of the editorial between July and December 2024 to rewrite sentences for improved phrasing, flow, and word choice.

quality_tier_rationale: This is an editorial/theoretical special-issue overview rather than an empirical evaluation of an AI tool. It does not report a study design, comparison group, or measured outcomes for the tool itself.
impact_tier_rationale: No effect sizes or outcome data are reported for ChatGPT in this paper. The only described use is author-side writing assistance for the manuscript, not a measured educational impact.
